_comment: FareRise parser + behaviour overrides. Every key is optional; anything absent, empty or malformed falls back to the value compiled into the app. Edits go live within 30 minutes, with no Play release and no reinstall. THIS FILE IS LIVE FOR EVERY USER - bump version on each edit and keep git history clean so a bad value can be reverted in seconds.
_autoaccept_comment: A platform runs LIVE only once its audit log shows the tap LANDING - not merely being sent. Lyft: proven, its Accept is a real node and performAction(ACTION_CLICK) cannot be filtered (3 confirmed LIVE TAPPED, sched->fire 3-9ms). UBER: TURNED OFF 2026-08-03. Uber's Accept is canvas with no node, so the only path is a synthetic gesture, and Uber ignores it - 0 of 4 live gesture taps ever became a ride, and all 4 goldens on 2026-08-02 ($17.14/$20.03/$19.56/$25.08) were reported accepted while OutcomeLog shows none were. Live on Uber buys nothing and is the only behaviour carrying ToS exposure. Hopp: no audit entry of any kind - stays clamped. Cancel window tunable via autoaccept_cancel_window_ms.
_autoaccept_threshold_comment: Auto-accept ANY green (ACCEPT) offer at or above BOTH bars ($/hr and $/km), on top of goldens. Driver ask 2026-07-27. Both must be >0 or the feature is off. Only pays where the tap lands: Lyft click works; Uber tap is under test (node-click). Raise/lower here, no rebuild.
_ocr_postal_comment: Repairs an OCR S->$ garble in Uber postal codes ('M1K 4$9' -> 'M1K 4S9'). The stray $ used to open a false fare slot. Set false if it ever mangles a real value.
_two_legs_comment: Lyft and Hopp always render BOTH a pickup leg and a trip leg. When only one is on the tree the sheet is still drawing, and taking that single line as the trip collapsed a 20km Scarborough->Downtown into '1.4km/2min' and carded it at $161/hr. With this true the parse is held as incomplete and retried instead. Set false to restore the old single-line behaviour if cards ever stop appearing.
_gps_coverage_comment: GPS km must exceed paid-trip km; below this multiple of paid km the day is treated as tracking-gapped and fuel is billed on paid km instead, so Net is not overstated. 0 disables.
_accept_labels_comment: Exact lowercase match for the Accept control on all three apps. If a platform renames its button, auto-accept dies silently until this list is updated - which is why it lives here and not in the APK. Keep it EXACT-match only: adding 'accept' as a substring would match 'Auto-accept', 'Accepted' and Lyft's 'Accept invite'.
_packages_comment: Watched driver apps. Lets a package rename, or a fourth platform, ship without a Play release.
_verdict_min_fare_comment: Below this fare the card cannot say ACCEPT - it says BORDERLINE. The offer still shows, still buzzes, still carries every number; it just stops presenting itself as a clear yes. $/hr on a short job assumes the next paid ride starts the instant this one ends, which it never does, so small fares quote a rate they cannot hold. On the driver's own 964-offer log a $10 floor cut ACCEPT cards from 425 to 181 and lifted precision from 10.3% to 19.7%, costing 5 genuine takes out of 28. Raise to 12 for a stricter card, 0 to disable.
_verdict_dead_comment: Minutes of unpaid wait attributed to each trip. COMPUTED AND LOGGED ONLY - it does not move the verdict yet. Wiring it in without re-deriving the driver's min $/hr turned 833 of 964 historical offers into SKIP and downgraded 28 of the 35 rides actually taken, because that bar is calibrated against engaged time. Measured ~15 min on this driver (33 min per accepted trip vs 18 min engaged). Left here so realPerHr accumulates in the log for the calibration pass.
